AboutSection.title: About us
AboutSection.body: Bed & Breakfast Klein Ockenburgh offers a quiet and personal stay in The Hague. You stay in a comfortable ground-floor room with a private entrance, while the beach, dunes and city are all within easy reach.

AreaSection.title: Around the B&B
AreaSection.intro: Our B&B is in a quiet and convenient part of The Hague. The beach, nature and the city centre are easy to reach by bike, car or public transport.
AreaSection.empty: Add places in the translations to populate this overview.

accessibility.title: Getting here & parking
paragraphs: Our B&B is easy to reach both by car and by public transport. We offer free parking on our own property right in front of the B&B. There is also secure space to store bicycles.
Would you like to explore the area by bike? You can easily rent bicycles from Orie Rijwielen, just 500 metres from our B&B. For rentals, you can contact them directly by email.
We are happy to help with practical advice and tips for scenic routes and useful local connections.

places.name: The Hague city centre
places.description: Ideal for shopping, museums, historic buildings and lively squares. The city centre includes the Binnenhof and many of The Hague's best-known sights.

places.name: Kijkduin
places.description: You can be on the beach within minutes by bike. Kijkduin is known for its quieter beaches and welcoming beach pavilions.

places.name: Scheveningen
places.description: Easy to reach by public transport or bicycle. Here you will find the Circustheater and the iconic Pier, among other attractions. In high season we advise against coming by car because of crowds and limited parking.

places.name: Ockenburgh estate
places.description: A beautiful green estate with woodland and walking paths, ideal for a relaxing walk. The estate has a restaurant and cafe, and live music is organised regularly.

places.name: Cycling routes
places.description: Several cycling junction routes connect to the national network nearby, including 21, 22 and 23 towards Kijkduin and the dunes, and 17 and 18 towards Westland and the southern coastal route. From here you can easily cycle to Westduinpark, Westland, Hoek van Holland or Meijendel.
